core_obligations: The stratification gives closed subspaces where the fibre degree is bounded by d.
The locus where the degree is bounded is open and contains the generic points.
Shrink to the open neighbourhood; conclude the fibres are bounded there.
difficulty_reason: A shrink-to-generic argument on the carded stratification.
